newsitem.title: USA: LCA-Vision sees 97 revs at $14.4 million.
newsitem.headline: LCA-Vision sees 97 revs at $14.4 million.

text.p: LCA-Vision Inc said Tuesday its acquisition of Summit Technology Inc's refractive centers international subsidiary will boost annualized revenues to $14.4 million this year.

The provider of laser vision treatment said it completed the acquisition of the Summit unit for l7 million shares of its common stock, or about $55 million based on LCA-Vision's closing stock price of 3-1/4 Monday.
It said the transaction positions LCA-Vision as the largest provider of laser vision treatment in the U.S., with double the number of locations ot its nearest competitor.
LCA-Vision projected the Summit unit's total 1997 revenues at $6.0 million.
The company posted a $1.8 million loss on revenues of $2.8 million in the first quarter ended March 31, compared with a $524,000 loss on revenues of $3.7 million in the 1996 quarter.
